chosen_line.card: All Streams Flow to the Sea

q1_what_did_you_play: I played Fathom the Tide on Nibbit, spending 6 Charge for its extra 6 damage, then played All Streams Flow to the Sea on Nibbit. This used both energy and dealt the highest known damage available this turn.
q2_other_line_considered: I seriously considered All Streams Flow to the Sea plus Coral Guard, because it would keep Charge at 12 and gain 5 Block against the telegraphed 12 damage attack, but it would deal much less damage.
q3_what_it_gave_up: The chosen line gave up 5 Block and left 6 Charge unspent compared with the guard line. It also accepted taking the full 12 damage, leaving HP at 36 instead of 41 if Coral Guard had been played.
q4_different_intent: Yes. If the enemy had telegraphed a much larger attack that threatened my HP, I would have prioritized Coral Guard for Block. Against the shown 12 damage attack, my HP is safe enough that extra damage is the better known trade.
